title: Equation discovery identifies a nonlinear reinforcement learning model of human choice
summary: Equation discovery algorithms were used to propose a Quadratic Q-Weighted model in which reward prediction errors follow nonlinear dynamics with a negativity bias. The abstract reports better predictive accuracy than classical models in 8 of 9 published datasets. The method is equation discovery, not a neural network, and the result is a behavioural model.
organization: Case Western Reserve University; University of Chicago; MIT

evidence.tested: Predictive accuracy of the discovered model compared with classical reinforcement learning models on nine published datasets.
evidence.unknown: Behavioural model fit to existing datasets; mechanism not tested experimentally; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Equation discovery algorithm proposing a differential-equation model of reinforcement learning from behaviour.

source_review.scope: Abstract read from Europe PMC metadata for this DOI; affiliations from Europe PMC or Crossref where stated. Publisher full text not accessed.
